content:
lina-support: opening escalation for ACME - private control plane mTLS failures from their NATed egress. intermittent, ~30% of connections RST before handshake completes. attaching logs they pasted.

lina-support: ```
Apr 14 14:02:11 svc-proxy kernel: TCP: 192.0.2.45:51734 > 198.51.100.12:443 RST
14:02:11.123456 IP client -> controlplane: TLSv1.3 ClientHello, len 512
14:02:11.123457 IP middlebox -> client: RST
```

max-sre: do we know if it's TLS-inspection or a middlebox rewriting traffic? :thinking:

lina-support: customer claims they only inspect external hosts but have split-horizon DNS. sometimes controlplane resolves to internal VIPs. they ran a dig and got large DNS responses.

raj-oncall: can we get a pcap + digs + openssl s_client from their edge? need to see fragmentation, SNI, who sent the RST.

lina-support: asked them to run these and upload pcap: 
```
# from their egress box
dig +short controlplane.redwood.acme @10.1.1.1
dig +bufsize=512 controlplane.redwood.acme @10.1.1.1
openssl s_client -connect controlplane.redwood:443 -tls1_3 -servername controlplane.redwood -msg
tcpdump -n -s 0 -w /tmp/mtls.pcap 'host controlplane.redwood and port 443'
```

eli-net: common failure mode: ClientHello gets fragmented at IP layer (large UDP/DNS or PMTUD issue) and the middlebox either drops fragments or can't reassemble the CH correctly -> server never sees full CH/certs. also some NGFWs choke on unknown TLS1.3 extensions.

lina-support: they uploaded pcap -> link in thread. quick look shows initial ClientHello split across two IP fragments; RST originates from their middlebox IP 10.254.3.1 before server responds fully.

max-sre: reading the handshake: client offered TLS1.3 ciphers plus legacy TLS1.2 CBC suites. control plane only allows TLS1.3 by policy in this cluster; but even if TLS1.2 offered, CH fragmentation should not cause RST. pcap snippet: 
```
Handshake Type: ClientHello
Legacy Version: 0x0303
Cipher Suites: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 (0x1301), TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305 (0x1303), TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA (0x002F)
Extensions: server_name (SNI=controlplane.redwood)
...
IP frag 1: handshake header + partial extensions
IP frag 2: rest of extensions + SNI
```

raj-oncall: RST coming from 10.254.3.1 indicates the customer's NGFW/NAT is terminating or deciding to drop stream. ask them to check TLS-bump rules and fragment handling. also verify EDNS/UDP size on their DNS resolver - large UDP DNS responses can trigger fallback and affect MTU/fragmentation patterns.

lina-support: sent repro steps for them to try disabling TLS-inspection for that FQDN and to force smaller MSS to see change: 
```
# quick test on edge (temporary)
sudo iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1200
openssl s_client -connect controlplane.redwood:443 -tls1_3 -servername controlplane.redwood
```

eli-net: if disabling inspection fixes it, that's strong signal NGFW is rewriting/dropping fragments or doesn't support TLS1.3 passthrough with mTLS. recommended permanent actions:
- add controlplane.redwood and our published control plane IP ranges to TLS-bump bypass list
- ensure split-horizon DNS returns minimal A records; avoid large TXT/opt records that enlarge UDP DNS replies
- allow fragmented packets or increase MTU on egress path / avoid aggressive MSS clamping
- verify NAT device preserves TCP sequence/does not RST on unknown extensions

lina-support: customer tested - disabling TLS inspection for the FQDN allowed the handshake to complete consistently. they're opening a change to add bypass. they asked what else we can recommend to avoid future regressions.

max-sre: add runbook steps: 1) verify pcap shows ClientHello fragmentation; 2) check RST source IP; 3) ask customer to bypass TLS-bump for control plane; 4) if they cannot bypass, request vendor confirm TLS1.3+extension passthrough and fragment reassembly support.

raj-oncall: i'll create an internal KB note and link sample tcpdump and the iptables test command. tagging infra-bot to archive pcap and note.

infra-bot: archived /uploads/1995012345/mtls.pcap -> s3://redwood-support-uploads/1995012345/mtls.pcap (access: internal only)

lina-support: thanks all — marking as "waiting on customer change". will follow up after their change window. :white_check_mark:
